$comment: Frontend only. The Nest backend runs on Fly.io (fly.toml + docs/ops/DEPLOY_VERCEL_FLY.md);
this project must never build or run a backend service or container.
There are deliberately NO rewrites here. Vercel expands \${VAR} in vercel.json rewrite
destinations at the routing layer, which does not decrypt Secret-type variables —
with API_URL stored as a Secret the destination resolved to nothing and every request
fell through to the Next.js 404. The /uploads, /socket.io and /auth/oauth rewrites
therefore live in next.config.ts, which reads process.env inside the Node process and
uses the same serverApiUrl() as the /api/proxy BFF. That keeps API_URL the single
backend switch AND works with a secret value.
Lives at apps/frontend/vercel.json, not the repo root: Root Directory is apps/frontend
and Vercel reads vercel.json from inside it.
